# HMD WhatsApp Gateway API

> A self-hosted WhatsApp messaging gateway. Access is invite-only and gated by a bearer API key issued by the operator; there is no self-service signup. Integration is over the HTTP API only: send and read WhatsApp messages (to individuals or to groups), react, set presence, and receive signed webhooks. Base URL is https://wa.example.com and every request carries `Authorization: Bearer <API key>` with `Content-Type: application/json`.

## Getting started

- [Authentication](https://wa.example.com/docs/authentication): Bearer-token auth, key format, scopes, and IP allowlists.
- [Scopes](https://wa.example.com/docs/scopes): the six API key scopes, what each grants, and which endpoints require them.
- [Get an API key](https://wa.example.com/docs/api-keys): invite-only key issuance by the operator; what to include in a request.
- [Quickstart](https://wa.example.com/docs/quickstart): send your first message with a complete request and response.
- [Core concepts](https://wa.example.com/docs/concepts): keys, sessions, projects, the purpose field, message lifecycle, and phone format.

## Sending

- [Send a message](https://wa.example.com/docs/endpoints/send): POST /v1/messages, full body reference, success and error shapes.
- [Message body types](https://wa.example.com/docs/messages): the text, image, and document body kinds with examples.
- [Reactions](https://wa.example.com/docs/endpoints/reactions): set or clear an emoji reaction with POST or DELETE /v1/messages/:id/reactions.
- [Presence and typing](https://wa.example.com/docs/endpoints/presence): POST /v1/sessions/:sessionId/presence for online and typing indicators.

## Reading

- [Get a message](https://wa.example.com/docs/endpoints/get): GET /v1/messages/:id for the full record and status history.
- [List messages](https://wa.example.com/docs/endpoints/list): GET /v1/messages for a paginated, reverse-chronological list.
- [List groups](https://wa.example.com/docs/endpoints/groups): GET /v1/groups to discover the WhatsApp group JIDs the bound session belongs to, for use as `to` on a group send.
- [Session status](https://wa.example.com/docs/endpoints/status): GET /v1/worker/status to check the session connection state.
- [Health check](https://wa.example.com/docs/endpoints/health): GET /api/health, an unauthenticated liveness probe.

## Reliability

- [Idempotency](https://wa.example.com/docs/idempotency): the idempotencyKey body field and the TTL-bound deduplication window.
- [Rate limits](https://wa.example.com/docs/rate-limits): the per-key, per-IP, and global tiers plus the per-recipient cap.
- [Errors](https://wa.example.com/docs/errors): the flat error envelope and the complete error-code catalogue.

## Webhooks

- [Webhooks overview](https://wa.example.com/docs/webhooks): event categories, delivery semantics, and the retry schedule.
- [Verifying signatures](https://wa.example.com/docs/webhooks/verify): the X-HMD-Signature HMAC-SHA256 scheme and verification code.
- [Event payloads](https://wa.example.com/docs/webhooks/events): field reference and JSON for every event type.

## For AI agents and codegen

- [OpenAPI specification](https://wa.example.com/openapi.json): machine-readable OpenAPI 3.1 for client codegen, Postman, and Insomnia.
- [Full integration reference](https://wa.example.com/llms-full.txt): the complete corpus as a single markdown document.
